about_pullquote: I started this business to give St Albans a fair, honest electrician.
about_para_1: Matthew Electrical & Heating was founded on the principle that local families and businesses deserve straightforward, reliable electrical work without the inflated bills. For over 15 years, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, fixing the problem right, and explaining what we've done in plain English. Every member of our team is properly qualified and insured.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we don't cut corners or upsell unnecessary work. Whether it's an emergency call-out at 10pm or a planned rewire, we treat your home with the same care we'd give our own. We're based right here in St Albans, so we know the area and our neighbours know us.

reviews.text: Boiler packed up in December and I panicked. Matthew came out the same day, diagnosed a dead pump, and had us back on heating in two hours. No faffing about, no silly prices. Top bloke.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had dodgy wiring in an old cottage we'd just bought. Matthew did a full survey, explained what needed doing, and then rewired two rooms without any mess. Very professional and actually cheaper than the first two quotes.
reviews.author: Emma R.

reviews.text: Called on a Friday evening with a tripped electrics problem. Matthew turned up within 45 minutes, found a faulty appliance, and sorted it straight away. Will definitely use again. Exactly what you want from a local tradesman.
reviews.author: Paul M.
